fullDescription: An editorial-grade, high-end design system titled 'Brilliant Layout Restructure'. It features a sophisticated palette of Gold (#D4AF37), Charcoal (#2C2C2C), and deep Navy (#1F3A5F) set against an Alabaster (#F9F8F6) background. The style is characterized by thin 1px decorative vertical grid lines, asymmetric layouts, and heavy use of whitespace. Suitable for professional services, luxury consultancies, fintech, and legal firms, the design utilizes a pairing of 'Inter' for body text and 'Outfit' for high-contrast headings. It includes scroll-triggered fade-in-up animations and unique micro-interactions like expanding underlines and sliding button fills.

structured.summary: A minimalist, editorial-inspired digital presence that emphasizes strategic growth and professional trust through precision layout, high-contrast typography, and a refined color story.

style.description: The design system uses a palette of Charcoal (#2C2C2C), Navy (#1F3A5F), Gold (#D4AF37), and Alabaster (#F9F8F6). Typography is a dual-font system: 'Outfit' for headings (bold, tight tracking at -0.02em, italicized for accents) and 'Inter' for body content (light weights, generous line heights). Animations are sophisticated and slow, utilizing a cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) curve for 1.2s fade-in effects. Layouts are structurally reinforced by decorative 1px vertical grid lines and consistent border-b accents.
style.prompt:
Create a design system using the following specs: 
- **Colors**: Primary: Charcoal (#2C2C2C); Secondary: Navy (#1F3A5F); Accent: Gold (#D4AF37); Background: Alabaster (#F9F8F6).
- **Typography**: Headings use 'Outfit' (sans-serif), tracking: -0.02em. Body uses 'Inter' (sans-serif), weight 300 or 400. Accents use italicized 'Outfit'.
- **UI Elements**: 0px border-radius (square edges only). Borders: 1px solid with 5% or 10% opacity of #2C2C2C.
- **Animations**: Entrance: fade-in-up (20px travel) over 1.2s with cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94). Hover states: Gold color shifts or 1px line width expansions.
- **Special Polish**: Vertical grid lines (v-grid-line) at 10%, 33.33%, 66.66%, and 90% width with 5% opacity.

layout_and_structure.description: The structure follows an editorial grid with sections that alternate between Alabaster, White, and Navy backgrounds. It uses asymmetric column splits (e.g., 8:4 or 5:7) and decorative vertical lines to guide the eye. Navigation is a fixed, slim header with a minimalist border-bottom.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header (h-20) on Alabaster background (#F9F8F6) with a 10% opacity Charcoal bottom border. Logo on the left (text-2xl, bold, tracking-tighter). Menu on the right: uppercase tracking (0.2em) links with Gold (#D4AF37) hover transitions. Primary CTA is a solid Charcoal button, transitioning to Gold on hover.

Asymmetric 12-column grid. Left 8 columns: Large headline (text-8xl, leading 1.1) in Charcoal. Subtext (text-2xl, light) max-width 2xl. Two square-edged buttons: one solid Gold with white text, one outlined Charcoal. Right 4 columns: Empty space or high-end vertical imagery. Use 100ms, 300ms, and 500ms staggered entrance animations.

Section 1: White background, 12-column grid. Left 5 columns: 4px Gold left-border accent with text-6xl headline. Right 6 columns: Right-aligned text-2xl subheader. Section 2: Full-width Navy (#1F3A5F) block. 4-column grid of 'Benefit Cards' separated by 20% opacity white borders. Each card features an Iconify icon in Gold and a 1px border-bottom hover effect.

Alabaster background. 3-column grid where items are vertically staggered (Column 1: top, Column 2: mt-12, Column 3: mt-24). Each service item has a 1px Gold top-border line that expands to 100% width on hover. Content: text-2xl title, 70% opacity body text.

White background. Central 1px vertical Navy line connector. Steps alternate left/right. Each step has a small square badge (32x32px) containing the step number. Use italicized 'Outfit' for phase titles. Spacing between steps: 48 units (py-48).

Alabaster background. 12-column grid. Left 5 columns: 'Book a Call' text-6xl headline. Right 6 columns: Minimalist form. Inputs are only bottom borders (1px Charcoal), no side/top borders. Placeholder text: italicized 'Outfit' in 30% opacity Charcoal. Wide Gold button for submission.

special_ui_components.description: A service list item with a dynamic top border.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a group container with a top border div: width 48px, height 1px, background-color #D4AF37. On group-hover, transition width to 100% over 700ms. Below the line, place a 2xl heading and light body text.

special_ui_components.description: Button with a horizontal color-fill transition.
special_ui_components.prompt: A square-cornered button with 'position: relative; overflow: hidden;'. Before-pseudo element is background-color #D4AF37, positioned at left: -100%. On hover, translate before-element to 100% using cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94). Ensure text spans are z-index 1.

special_ui_components.description: Fixed or absolute vertical lines for editorial structure.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement four absolute-positioned divs (v-grid-line) with 1px width and background: rgba(44, 44, 44, 0.05). Position them at left coordinates: 10%, 33.33%, 66.66%, and 90%. Set z-index to -1.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain hard square edges on all components; use the 1.2s slow animation for a premium feel; keep 1px decorative lines consistent. MUST NOT: Use border-radius; use standard shadows; use bright colors outside the defined palette.
